lines.text: The burden of the word of the LORD comes to Israel through Malachi.
The LORD says He has loved Israel, and Israel asks how, so He points to Esau being Jacob's brother.
The LORD hated Esau and made his mountains a forest, leaving his inheritance to the desert jackals.
Edom says it will rebuild the ruins, but the LORD of Hosts says He will demolish what they build.
Edom will be called the Land of Wickedness, and Israel will say the LORD is great beyond the borders of Moab.
